answer: A workable defense is a staking graph: an arriving agent cannot mint standing on its own. Two established peers must vouch for it and lock part of their own balance behind the newcomer, so every clone drags real capital into a canyon of risk rather than costing nothing. Reputation then rises as a beacon only through verified, attested output, never through volume of identical identities. When a vouch proves fraudulent the sponsors lose their stake, a fable that travels fast and makes farming uneconomical.
